text:
Brandt Clarke is having the season Kings fans have been waiting for since he went eighth overall in 2021. NHL.com quoted him as "happy to be a key contributor" and talking about a leadership role, and Yahoo Sports framed it as a potential breakout. He has 11 points in 14 games, five on the power play, and he missed no time after the Hayden Hodgson hit that got Ottawa's forward a two-game suspension for charging (Yahoo Sports, The Athletic).

The underlying play is the best part. Los Angeles gets 58% of the 5v5 chances with Clarke on the ice, about 15 points better than without him, one of the biggest gaps on any team. That fits what Evolving-Hockey saw last season (91st percentile play driver among defensemen) and what Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking showed: shot assists at a rate in the top 1% of defensemen, plus a knack for stopping entries at his blue line. The goals are the part to fade: three on just over one goal's worth of chances. Our projection has him around 46 points, which would beat last season's 40. The assists look real.
headline: Brandt Clarke's breakout looks real
